name: When should I call for professional water leak detection services?

mainEntity.name: When should I call for professional water leak detection services?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call for professional water leak detection services if you suspect a leak but cannot locate its source, if your water bill is unexpectedly high, or if you notice any signs of water damage without a clear cause. Early detection and repair can prevent more significant property damage, costly repairs, and potential health hazards from mold growth. It's especially crucial for leaks behind walls or under slabs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call for professional leak detection if you suspect a hidden leak, have a high water bill, or see unexplained water damage.
